svg.aria-label: Sequencing, de novo assembly and reference comparison: a 9-nucleotide genome (3 amino acids), 5 reads, one nucleotide changing an amino acid
svg.text: The machine cuts the genome into short reads
5 reads, each covering only part of the 9-nucleotide genome.
Use the overlapping pieces to stitch them together
Stitch the 5 overlapping reads → a complete 9-nucleotide genome (3 codons).
One nucleotide difference (position 5) changes codon AAA to AGA — i.e. Lys (K) to Arg (R).
